title.narrative: Ethiopia Productive Safety Net APL (Adaptable Program Loan) III Project

description.narrative: This MDTF will provide cofinancing for the IDA APL III Project to support the next phase of Ethiopia's Productive Safety Net Program covering the period 2010-2014. As such, it will support the overall development objective of the Program which aims to reduce household vulnerability, improve resilience to shocks and promote sustainable community development in food insecure areas of rural Ethiopia. This is to be achieved through continued consolidation of a safety net system that: (i) provides timely, predictable and appropriate transfers to beneeficiary households; (ii) creates productive and sustainable community assets that contribute to the large-scale rehabilitation of severely degraded areas; (iii) stimulates local markets through demand linkages; (iv) establishes more effective responses to shocks to avoid destitution among affected households; and (v) integrates and effectively supports critical interventions that build assets, promote increased productivity, and encourage diversification at the household level.
